died.name: Galba
died.cause: prior to beheading by supporters of Otho
died.last_words: Strike, if it be for the Romans' good.

died.name: Vasco Núñez de Balboa
died.cause: on hearing a herald call him a "usurper of the rights of the Crown" while on the way to his execution by decapitation
died.last_words: That is false. I always have served my king loyally and sought to add to his domains.

died.name: Paolo Sarpi
died.desc: Venetian historian, prelate, scientist, canon lawyer and statesman

died.name: Massimo d'Azeglio
died.cause: seeing his estranged wife arrive at his bedside as he died
died.last_words: Ah, Luisa, you always arrive just as I'm leaving.

died.name: Victims of the Great Molasses Flood
died.cause: 21 people were killed and 150 injured after a large tank of molasses burst in Boston's North End.

died.name: Bill Masterton
died.cause: after sustaining fatal head injury in NHL game

died.name: Garfield M. Langhorn
died.desc: United States Army soldier and Medal of Honor recipient
died.cause: prior to falling on a grenade to protect wounded soldiers during the Vietnam War

born.name: Molière
born.cause: The French playwright suffered a pulmonary hemorrhage caused by tuberculosis while playing the part of a hypochondriac in his own play Le malade imaginaire. He disguised his convulsion as part of his performance and finished the show, which ends with his character dead in a chair. After the show, he was carried in the chair to his house, where he died.

born.name: Algernon Sidney
born.cause: prior to execution by beheading for treason
born.last_words: I know that my Redeemer liveth. I die for the good old cause.

born.name: Jacques Pierre Brissot
born.desc: French abolitionist and leading member of the Girondins
born.cause: singing these words along with 21 other Girondins before their execution
born.last_words: Rather death than slavery, is the motto of the French.

born.name: Ray Chapman
born.cause: referring to the pitcher who had fatally struck him with a pitch and to his wedding band On 16 August 1920, while he was up to bat, the 29-year-old Cleveland Indians baseball player was struck in the head by a pitch thrown by the New York Yankees' Carl Mays and died 12 hours later.
born.last_words: I'm all right; tell Mays not to worry... ring....Katie's ring.

born.name: Martin Luther King Jr.
born.cause: speaking to musician Ben Branch shortly before being assassinated
born.last_words: Ben, make sure you play 'Take My Hand, Precious Lord' in the meeting tonight. Play it real pretty.

born.name: Robert Alton Harris
born.cause: prior to execution by gas chamber
born.last_words: You can be a king or a street sweeper, but everyone dances with the Grim Reaper.
